title: fix: add security.txt
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a standards-compliant `/.well-known/security.txt` for `pollinations.ai`.
- Publishes `hello@pollinations.ai` and GitHub private security advisories as reporting contacts.
- Adds a canonical URL, preferred language, and expiry date.
- Resolves the Cloudflare Security Insights warning caused by the frontend fallback serving HTML at this path.

Checks:
- `npm run build`
- Verified the built file matches the source.
- Verified local response is `200 OK` with `text/plain; charset=utf-8`.

gist.headline: A mailbox for responsible bees
gist.blurb: The hive now keeps a proper note at `/.well-known/security.txt`. Security researchers get clear reporting routes instead of accidentally finding the frontend's HTML wallpaper.
gist.summary: Added a standards-compliant `/.well-known/security.txt` on pollinations.ai with hello@pollinations.ai and GitHub private security advisories as reporting contacts, plus canonical URL, language, and expiry metadata.
gist.impact: Security researchers and automated security tools now receive a 200 text/plain security policy at the expected path, with clear private reporting options.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as the hive's friendly security postmaster, placing a sealed letter into a tiny lime-green mailbox marked security.txt beside a cozy garden-web server. A retro CRT companion can display a simple 200 OK message, while flowers and code-vines make the reporting route feel clear and welcoming.
